layers.attribution: Copernicus Emergency Management Service (CEMS), EMSR758, AOI03
limitations: Shows one moment only. Water may have been present earlier or later.
Outside the satellite image footprint there is no information, which is not the same as safe.
Radar can miss shallow water, water under vegetation and water between buildings.
It is a record of a past event, not a forecast of future flooding.
layers.meaning: Area mapped as flooded from satellite radar after the 13-14 September 2024 flood near Pechea, Galati. It shows where water was seen on the observation date.
layers.title: Flood extent, first estimate (14 Sep 2024)
